name: 6" x 25' Homesaver Ultra Pro Insulation Kit
description: The HomeSaver UltraPro 25' Insulation Kit has all of the insulation materials you will need for a UL/ULC installation, including already cut to the right wrap width for your diameter of liner. ArmorMesh is required as part of HomeSaver UL listed installation. This 304 stainless woven wire mesh wraps the blanket insulation and holds it close to the pipe. ArmorMesh also makes FlexWrap highly resistant to snagging or tearing during installation. Insulation Kit includes: 25' Length FlexWrap cut to 6" wrap width, ArmorMesh, aluminum tape, clamp kit and spray adhesive.
